description: This Java class, FilterClassAdapter, extends ASM's ClassVisitor to filter out class members such as fields, methods, and inner classes based on access modifiers and custom filtering criteria. It is used to process Java bytecode (class files) to selectively include or exclude certain members depending on specified filters.

classes.name: FilterClassAdapter
classes.description: A class visitor that filters out class members (fields, methods, inner classes) based on access modifiers and custom filter criteria.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Records class header information like version, access, name, signature, superClass, and interfaces.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the visit to the class.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Visits a field in the class, applying filtering criteria based on access and name.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Visits a method in the class, applying filtering based on access, name, signature, and exceptions.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Visits annotations on the class. Currently passes through without filtering.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visits class attributes. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: visitInnerClass
methods.description: Visits an inner class, filtering based on access and name.

methods.name: visitOuterClass
methods.description: Visits the outer class info; currently a no-op.

methods.name: visitSource
methods.description: Visits source information; currently a no-op.
